column1: mother|n.|母親，媽媽|My mother cooks dinner every evening.|我媽媽每天晚上都會煮晚餐。|Mother's Day is in May.|母親節在五月。
sibling|n.|兄弟姊妹|Do you have any siblings?|你有兄弟姊妹嗎？|My sibling and I share a bedroom.|我和我的手足共用一間臥室。
grandfather|n.|祖父，外公|My grandfather tells us stories about the old days.|我爺爺會跟我們講以前的故事。|She visits her grandfather every Sunday.|她每個星期天都去探望外公。
grandmother|n.|祖母，外婆|My grandmother makes the best dumplings.|我奶奶做的水餃最好吃。|He lives with his grandmother in the countryside.|他和外婆一起住在鄉下。
grandparent|n.|祖父母，外祖父母|I spend every summer with my grandparents.|我每年夏天都和祖父母一起度過。|Both of my grandparents are over eighty.|我的祖父母都超過八十歲了。
grandson|n.|孫子，外孫|The old man took his grandson to the park.|老先生帶他的孫子去公園。|Their grandson just started school.|他們的孫子剛開始上學。
granddaughter|n.|孫女，外孫女|She bought a doll for her granddaughter.|她買了一個洋娃娃給她的孫女。|His granddaughter is learning to play the piano.|他的孫女正在學鋼琴。
uncle|n.|叔叔，舅舅，伯父|My uncle lives in Canada.|我叔叔住在加拿大。|We visited my uncle's farm last summer.|去年夏天我們去了我舅舅的農場。
aunt|n.|阿姨，姑姑，伯母|My aunt gave me a gift for my birthday.|我阿姨在我生日時送了我一份禮物。|He stays with his aunt during the holidays.|假期時他住在姑姑家。
nephew|n.|姪子，外甥|My nephew is five years old.|我的姪子五歲了。|She takes her nephew to the zoo every month.|她每個月都帶外甥去動物園。
niece|n.|姪女，外甥女|My niece loves drawing.|我的姪女很愛畫畫。|He bought a birthday cake for his niece.|他為他的外甥女買了生日蛋糕。
wife|n.|妻子，太太|He called his wife to say he would be late.|他打電話給太太說他會晚到。|My wife and I have been married for ten years.|我太太和我結婚十年了。
baby|n.|嬰兒，寶寶|The baby smiled at me.|那個寶寶對我微笑。|She is going to have a baby next month.|她下個月就要生寶寶了。
toddler|n.|學步的幼兒|The toddler took her first steps today.|那個幼兒今天邁出了第一步。|It is hard to keep up with a toddler.|要跟上一個學步幼兒真不容易。
widow|n.|寡婦|The widow lives alone in a small house.|那位寡婦獨自住在一間小房子裡。|He left his house to his widow.|他把房子留給了他的遺孀。
orphan|n.|孤兒|The orphan was adopted by a kind family.|那名孤兒被一個善良的家庭收養了。|The charity takes care of orphans.|這個慈善機構照顧孤兒。
stepfather|n.|繼父|My stepfather taught me how to ride a bike.|我的繼父教我騎腳踏車。|She gets along well with her stepfather.|她和繼父相處得很好。
stepmother|n.|繼母|His stepmother cooks very well.|他的繼母很會做菜。|She wrote a letter to her stepmother.|她寫了一封信給她的繼母。
fisherman|n.|漁夫，漁民|The fisherman went out to sea before dawn.|漁夫在黎明前出海。|An old fisherman sold us fresh fish.|一位老漁夫賣給我們新鮮的魚。
policeman|n.|男警察|The policeman asked for my ID.|警察要求看我的身分證。|A policeman helped the lost child find his mother.|一位警察幫迷路的小孩找到了媽媽。
soldier|n.|軍人，士兵|The soldier stood guard at the gate.|士兵在大門口站崗。|My uncle was a soldier for ten years.|我叔叔當過十年的軍人。
singer|n.|歌手|She is my favorite singer.|她是我最喜歡的歌手。|The singer waved to the crowd.|歌手向群眾揮手。
barber|n.|理髮師|The barber cut my hair very short.|理髮師把我的頭髮剪得很短。|My father goes to the barber once a month.|我爸爸每個月去理髮店一次。
hairdresser|n.|美髮師|My hairdresser suggested a new hairstyle.|我的美髮師建議我換個新髮型。|She made an appointment with the hairdresser.|她向美髮師預約了時間。
veterinarian|n.|獸醫|The veterinarian checked our dog carefully.|獸醫仔細檢查了我們的狗。|She wants to become a veterinarian because she loves animals.|她因為愛動物而想當獸醫。
wound|n.|傷口|The nurse cleaned the wound with water.|護理師用水清洗傷口。|The wound on his knee is healing.|他膝蓋上的傷口正在癒合。
bruise|n.|瘀青|I have a big bruise on my arm.|我手臂上有一大塊瘀青。|The fall left a bruise on her leg.|那次跌倒在她腿上留下了瘀青。
bandage|n.|繃帶|The doctor put a bandage on his finger.|醫生在他的手指上包了繃帶。|Change the bandage every day.|每天都要換繃帶。
dizzy|adj.|頭暈的|I feel dizzy when I stand up too fast.|我站起來太快時會覺得頭暈。|The hot room made her dizzy.|悶熱的房間讓她頭暈。
nausea|n.|噁心，反胃|She felt nausea on the boat.|她在船上覺得想吐。|This medicine may cause nausea.|這種藥可能會引起噁心感。
fitting|n.|試穿|The fitting room is on the second floor.|試衣間在二樓。|I have a fitting for my wedding dress tomorrow.|我明天要試穿婚紗。
soccer|n.|足球|The boys play soccer after school.|男孩們放學後踢足球。|Soccer is the most popular sport in the world.|足球是世界上最受歡迎的運動。
baseball|n.|棒球|We watched a baseball game on TV.|我們在電視上看了一場棒球比賽。|Baseball is very popular in Taiwan.|棒球在台灣非常受歡迎。
basketball|n.|籃球|He is tall and plays basketball well.|他個子高，籃球打得很好。|We play basketball in the park every weekend.|我們每個週末都在公園打籃球。
tennis|n.|網球|She plays tennis twice a week.|她一週打兩次網球。|Let's book a tennis court for Saturday.|我們來預約星期六的網球場吧。
badminton|n.|羽毛球|My parents play badminton in the morning.|我爸媽早上打羽毛球。|Badminton is a fast game that needs good reflexes.|羽毛球是一種需要良好反應的快速運動。
volleyball|n.|排球|The girls are practicing volleyball in the gym.|女孩們正在體育館練習排球。|She joined the school volleyball team.|她加入了學校的排球隊。
swimming|n.|游泳|Swimming is a great way to stay fit.|游泳是保持健康的好方法。|I go swimming every Tuesday evening.|我每個星期二晚上去游泳。
running|n.|跑步|Running in the morning makes me feel good.|早上跑步讓我感覺很棒。|He bought new shoes for running.|他買了新的跑步鞋。
jogging|n.|慢跑|My dad goes jogging along the river every day.|我爸爸每天沿著河邊慢跑。|Jogging is easier on your knees than sprinting.|慢跑比衝刺對膝蓋的負擔小。
cycling|n.|騎自行車|We enjoy cycling around the lake.|我們喜歡騎單車環湖。|Cycling to work saves a lot of money.|騎單車上班可以省下很多錢。
skiing|n.|滑雪|We went skiing in Japan last winter.|我們去年冬天去日本滑雪。|Skiing can be dangerous for beginners.|滑雪對初學者可能很危險。
skating|n.|溜冰，滑冰|Ice skating is popular in winter.|滑冰在冬天很受歡迎。|The kids are learning skating at the rink.|孩子們正在溜冰場學溜冰。
boxing|n.|拳擊|He trains in boxing three times a week.|他每週練三次拳擊。|Boxing requires strength and speed.|拳擊需要力量和速度。
wrestling|n.|摔角，角力|Wrestling is an old Olympic sport.|摔角是一項古老的奧運項目。|My brother is on the school wrestling team.|我弟弟是學校摔角隊的成員。
gymnastics|n.|體操|She won a medal in gymnastics.|她在體操項目中贏得了一面獎牌。|Gymnastics needs balance and flexibility.|體操需要平衡感和柔軟度。
yoga|n.|瑜伽|I do yoga every morning to relax.|我每天早上做瑜伽放鬆。|There is a yoga class at six o'clock.|六點有一堂瑜伽課。
hiking|n.|健行，登山|We went hiking in the mountains on Sunday.|我們星期天去山上健行。|Hiking boots are important for long trips.|長途健行時，登山靴很重要。
climbing|n.|攀爬，攀岩|Rock climbing is both fun and challenging.|攀岩既有趣又有挑戰性。|He took up climbing after he moved to the city.|他搬到城市後開始攀岩。
diving|n.|潛水，跳水|Diving in Kenting is very popular.|在墾丁潛水非常受歡迎。|She took a diving course last summer.|她去年夏天上了潛水課。
surfing|n.|衝浪|Surfing is popular on the east coast.|衝浪在東海岸很受歡迎。|He learned surfing from his cousin.|他向表哥學會了衝浪。
medal|n.|獎牌|She won a gold medal in swimming.|她在游泳項目中贏得一面金牌。|The athlete wore the medal around his neck.|那位運動員把獎牌掛在脖子上。
trophy|n.|獎盃|The team lifted the trophy together.|球隊一起舉起獎盃。|The trophy is in a glass case at school.|獎盃放在學校的玻璃櫃裡。
racket|n.|球拍|He bought a new tennis racket.|他買了一支新的網球拍。|Hold the racket with both hands.|雙手握住球拍。
bat|n.|球棒|The player swung the bat and hit the ball.|球員揮動球棒把球擊出去。|He bought a baseball bat for his son.|他為兒子買了一支棒球棍。
